gaps.discriminates: Venous stasis ulcer vs. arterial insufficiency ulcer (e.g., ischemic ulcer) — ABI <0.9 would suggest significant PAD and contraindicate standard compression, fundamentally altering diagnosis and management.

Venous stasis ulcer vs. diabetic neurotrophic/ischemic ulcer — uncontrolled diabetes can independently cause non-healing ulcers and worsen venous ulcer outcomes; presence would necessitate dual-pathway diagnosis (e.g., I83.019 + E11.621).

Venous stasis ulcer vs. malnutrition-mediated impaired healing — hypoalbuminemia (<3.0 g/dL) may shift priority to nutritional optimization before definitive venous intervention and could indicate systemic contributors not yet captured.
